# This document has been replaced — read https://www.appwithai.org/llms.md

`llms-full.txt` was one of four protocol documents for writing or changing an EML
model. They are now one document:

    https://www.appwithai.org/llms.md

Fetch that URL and follow it instead of this file. If your reader refuses
`text/markdown` (some do, with "400 Unsupported content-type"), fetch the
identical plain-text copy instead: https://www.appwithai.org/llms.txt It carries the whole
language reference that was here, and one procedure for both requests:

- **A new model** — when you are given a description of a business and no
  `.mmd`, build the model from it.
- **A change to an existing model** — when you are given a `.mmd` (attached,
  pasted, or as a path or URL), change that file in place, hand back the
  whole of it, and prove nothing in it was lost.

It runs as office hours — one decision at a time with the user, or in one pass
when they ask you to just build it — and it requires a complete Application
Dictionary, including every form laid out as headed sections of two-column
rows (`%%section`).

The validators have not moved: https://www.appwithai.org/guide/checker.js and
https://www.appwithai.org/guide/fixer.js.
